note: Both sets capture the four Table 6-2 tower properties correctly, but Set A quotes the narrative sentence for the structural-damping ratio, which supports the 'all modes, isolated tower (without rotor-nacelle assembly mass)' conditions, whereas Set B quotes only the table row, which does not support those conditions. Set B also adds a third duplicate pair (overall (integrated) mass restated as overall integrated mass) beyond the height and CM-location duplicates both sets share. Set A is therefore slightly cleaner and better supported, though both sets pad the list with restatements of the same facts.
remarks: Both sets state height above ground and overall height (87.6 m) as two claims, and CM location twice, from the same table rows; these are restatements rather than distinct facts. Set B's damping claim is factually right but its quote (the table row) omits the isolated-tower/rotor-nacelle condition that the claim asserts. Neither set notes the '1% critical' wording or the DOWEC/Ref. [14] provenance, which are minor.
